title: Liouville Rigidity for Real and Complex Degenerate Hessian Equations
summary: We prove Liouville rigidity theorems for translation-invariant real and complex Hessian equations in the viscosity sense, where the PDE is encoded by an admissible set $\mathcal{A}$. The main structural notion is Liouville admissibility, a recursive geometric condition requiring each quotient set to be either boundary compatible or to fall into a terminal class.
